description: This file contains unit tests for the JsonObjectMerger class, verifying merging and immutability behaviors of JSON object merging within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.enforcers package.

classes.name: MergeJsonObjectsTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that tests the functionality and immutability of the JsonObjectMerger class.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that the JsonObjectMerger class is immutable.

methods.name: emptyObjectsMergeToEmptyObject
methods.description: Verifies that merging two empty JSON objects results in an empty object.

methods.name: retainExtraFieldFromObject1
methods.description: Checks that fields from the first object are retained when the second object is empty.

methods.name: retainExtraFieldFromObject2
methods.description: Checks that fields from the second object are retained when the first object is empty.

methods.name: mergeFieldsFromBothObjects
methods.description: Verifies that fields from both objects are merged correctly.

methods.name: mergeFieldsInsideArrays
methods.description: Tests merging of nested arrays within JSON objects, ensuring fields inside arrays are merged properly.
